answer: The ivory panel is drawn blind, the dune escrow settles at close, and whisper lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 22% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 194 account operation therefore ties up 35 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
